script_text: Cancer, this week the cosmos is staging a full emotional reckoning — and you won't see it coming. Early week, the Moon in your 1st House opposes Pluto in your 7th House, triggering intense power dynamics in your closest relationships. Tuesday is the roughest day as Mercury squares Saturn, muddling communication at work. But Wednesday brings a stunning shift: Venus trines your ruling planet the Moon, flooding your 5th House of romance with magnetic energy — someone from your past resurfaces. By Thursday, Jupiter sextiles the Sun in your 10th House, opening a career door you didn't expect. Friday through Sunday, Mars energizes your 2nd House, boosting income and self-worth. Your best day is Wednesday because Venus trines your ruling Moon. Your worst day is Tuesday due to Mercury square Saturn. Cancer, this water sign week demands you trust your intuition over logic. Follow for daily updates.
